subject: Consolidate exhibits + SOW edits for Novamed capacity increase
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Nov 2025 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Consolidate exhibits + SOW edits for Novamed capacity increase

Team —

Novamed asked us to clean up the MSA exhibits and fold the new capacity/top-up flow into a single exhibit so their procurement/finance teams have one document to sign. They want +20% baseline capacity added to Exhibit E and a short SOW edit to reflect the new throughput unit definition (tokens/sec per vGPU-equivalent).

I attached a rough consolidation proposal (exhibit-consolidation-proposal_v1.pdf) and a redline of the SOW throughput language (sow-throughput-redline.docx). High level asks:
- Can Sales Ops confirm the billing code and impact to invoicing cadence?
- Karthik: can you review the technical wording on the throughput/unit definition and fee-table labels?
- Neha: we'll need a short legal clean version and a recommended contract stanza for "capacity top-up" to minimize risk on termination/proration.

Target timeline: get internal signoff by EOD 11/14, send to Novamed (Ellie) for review week of 11/17, and DocuSign by 11/21 if possible.

Attachments: exhibit-consolidation-proposal_v1.pdf, sow-throughput-redline.docx

Thanks,
Markus Klein
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Nov 2025 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Consolidate exhibits + SOW edits for Novamed capacity increase

On Tue, Nov 12, 2025 at 9:03 AM Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Novamed asked us to clean up the MSA exhibits and fold the new capacity/top-up flow into a single exhibit so their procurement/finance teams have one document to sign. ...

Thanks Markus — quick notes from engineering/PM:

1) Throughput definition: the current draft uses "tokens/sec per GPU" — recommend switching to "effective throughput (tokens/sec per vGPU-equivalent)" and add a parenthetical that clarifies expected batch/seq conditions (e.g., 2k seq, batch 8). That prevents misalignment when they change sequence assumptions.

2) Fee table: the draft consolidates line items but loses the distinction between reserved baseline and burst credits. I attached a redlined doc (sow-throughput-redline.docx) with a suggested two-row fee table: "Baseline (reserved vGPU-eq)" and "Burst (on-demand tokens)". Pricing impact shown in comments.

3) Alternative: if Legal prefers less churn, we can add a narrow "Exhibit G — Capacity Top-Up" instead of full consolidation; operationally it's the same but reduces legal review time. Tradeoff: extra exhibit in their system vs faster turnaround.

Who at Novamed is the procurement contact? If we have a PO number we can reference that in the exhibit.

-Karthik
Staff Product Manager, Serving
Redwood Inference

Attachment: sow-throughput-redline.docx (redlined fee table + technical note)

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Nov 2025 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Consolidate exhibits + SOW edits for Novamed capacity increase

Markus / Karthik —

Ops side:
- Billing code: we will use REV-INF-TS-01 and set invoice trigger at start-of-month following enactment. If they want prorated mid-month billing we need to confirm the effective date.
- Accounting impact: +20% baseline increases deferred revenue forecast; Finance wants a note in the exhibit that specifies the initial billing milestone.

Requesting approvals: please confirm the effective date (propose 2025-12-01) and whether Novamed will supply PO# or we should proceed on signed DocuSign without a PO. Once confirmed I will update Zuora and prepare a billing addendum.

Linking HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/004512 — please add any internal comments there so CS/Finance sees the change.

Laura Bennett
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Nov 2025 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Consolidate exhibits + SOW edits for Novamed capacity increase

Team —

I've reviewed the attached consolidation draft and flagged several contract points in legal_comments_msaclean.pdf. High-level:

- Keep a narrowly tailored proration clause referencing "Effective Date" and "billing milestone" to avoid ambiguity on top-up billing.
- Limit the termination liability for top-up capacity to a refund of unused pre-paid burst credits; do not expose Redwood to broader indemnity for capacity usage.
- Ensure Exhibit cross-references (Exhibit E -> Section 4.2) are updated to avoid dangling references.

If we go with the consolidation approach, I'll prepare a clean "Consolidated Exhibit E" and a short cover paragraph for the MSA. If we instead add a small Exhibit G, the legal delta is smaller and likely faster for Novamed counsel.

I can prepare a DocuSign-ready package once you confirm: consolidation vs new exhibit, effective date, and PO availability. Also copied below is an external counsel contact if Novamed wants to loop counsel: Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@counselco.com>.

Neha Kapoor
Legal Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Attachment: legal_comments_msaclean.pdf

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellie Summers <ellie@novamed.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Nov 2025 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Consolidate exhibits + SOW edits for Novamed capacity increase

Thanks all — quick summary and next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

1) Decision: consolidate into a single Exhibit E (Consolidated Exhibit E) with the updated SOW language per Karthik's throughput definition and Laura's suggested effective date of 2025-12-01.

2) Legal: Neha to produce a clean consolidated Exhibit E and short MSA cover paragraph. Legal to keep proration language narrow as noted.

3) Billing & Ops: Laura to update Zuora with billing code REV-INF-TS-01 and prepare the invoice milestone. Laura: proceed without PO on the assumption Novamed will provide PO within 2 weeks; we will not delay DocuSign for PO.

4) Signoff: Karthik to deliver the final technical wording for the SOW (fee-table + throughput parenthetical) by COB 11/17. Neha to prepare the DocuSign envelope once final wording is in.

Ellie — looping you here so Novamed has the plan. Please let us know if you want the smaller-exhibit route instead (Exhibit G) — that would be faster on your counsel side but we prefer consolidation for single-document clarity.

DocuSign draft link (internal): https://docs.redwood.com/ds/fake-envelope/ENV-2025-1114-78

Markus Klein
VP, Strategic Accounts
